title: Validation: problem
description: The problem sub-score (EE-026), at <venture>/purpose/validation/problem.json: the problem, who has it, how they cope today, and the cited evidence that it is real. A statement alone is the weakest form of this record; packages/naive/src/checks/check-validation.ts grades it from its evidence. forms holds the customer problem tree (EE-219): one root problem in statement, each form below it either a narrower case (parent) or a cause (cause_of), one form at a time the target, and each ICP's core problem named by that profile (icp-profile.schema.json core_problem). packages/naive/src/checks/check-problems.ts checks the tree and packages/naive/src/engine/problems.ts ranks it from the interviews.

statement.description: The problem in the words of the people who have it

segment.description: Who has it, specifically enough to find them

frequency.description: How often it happens to them

cost.description: What it costs them now: money, time, risk

workarounds.description: How they cope today; money or time already spent on a workaround is strong evidence

why_now.description: What has changed that makes the problem solvable or urgent now (EE-050)

forms.description: The customer problem tree (EE-050, EE-219): one root problem in statement, and each form a problem below it, assessed on its own so it can be validated or dropped without touching the root. Two relations hold the tree together, and they say different things: parent, a narrower case of the same problem (the opportunity solution tree, Torres 2021), and cause_of, a different problem that produces another (problem tree analysis in the Logical Framework Approach). The order the founder lists them in is their own order, which the ranking falls back to as a hypothesis before any interview codes them (packages/naive/src/engine/problems.ts). These are the customer's problems; the business's own problems are decisions, seams and handoffs, never forms here

id.description: Unique among the forms, and never root, which names the record's own statement

segment.description: Only when narrower than the root's

parent.description: The form this one is a narrower case of (Torres's opportunity solution tree): the same problem for fewer people, or in one situation. Left out, the form sits directly under the record's statement, so a flat list of forms is a tree one level deep

cause_of.description: The forms this problem is a cause of (the Logical Framework Approach's problem tree): a different problem that produces them. Never the same form as parent: a narrower case is one shape of the same problem, a cause is another problem behind it

status.description: open, a live problem; target, the one problem being worked on now, which at most one form carries and only a person sets (the record is gated, so an agent's write is a draft a person accepts); parked, live but deliberately not now; dropped, ruled out by evidence. Primary, secondary and tertiary are not statuses: they are the computed ranking's labels (packages/naive/src/engine/problems.ts)

probability.description: The Jev probability that the problem is real and worth solving for this segment; the evidence grade weighs it in the validation score
